controlled.checkpoint_selection: Minimum mean validation relative L2 over horizons T/8,T/4,T/2,T. Matched checkpoints minimize the absolute log ratio of validation error to the supervised best error, without using semigroup error or test predictions.
controlled.matching_eligibility: Both validation errors <0.02 and their ratio between 0.8 and 1.25. Report all seeds and any failed eligibility checks.
controlled.uncertainty: Paired crossed bootstrap of training seeds and shared test-initial-condition identities; 10000 resamples; 95 percent percentile intervals; bootstrap seed 20261021.
controlled.scope: Controlled learned surrogate comparisons; not a reproduction of published PINO benchmark numbers.
controlled.pilot: Separate dataset seed 20261011; validation-only pilots, excluded from all test results.

external.selection_rule: Fixed parameter subset chosen by lexicographic filename intersection of official splits before training.
external.provenance: Raw source files copied from read-only mounted drive with matching streamed source and destination SHA-256.
external.interpretation: A bounded integration/application study on regenerated inputs; comparisons are within architecture. Report seed spread descriptively; overlapping temporal windows are not independent confidence units.
